checklists.name: Go Engineering Standards
checklists.description: Validation checklist for Go code style, concurrency, error handling, and static analysis.

items.statement: Go source code passes gofmt, govet, and golangci-lint without unaddressed warnings.
Error handling is explicit (if err != nil) and error strings are formatted without capitalized leading letters or punctuation.
Goroutines manage lifecycle, use context.Context for cancellation propagation, and avoid goroutine leaks.
Tests run clean with the race detector enabled (go test -race ./...) without data races.
Interfaces are defined by the consumer, kept small and focused, and unexported unless public export is explicitly required.

obligationDefinitions.title: Go module vulnerabilities must be tracked and remediated within SLA
obligationDefinitions.description: A vulnerability disclosed against a dependency in go.mod must be triaged and remediated within its severity's SLA; govulncheck flags reachable vulnerabilities specifically, so an unaddressed finding is a real, exploitable exposure, not theoretical.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: Every reachable Critical/High vulnerability reported by govulncheck is remediated or carries an approved waiver within its SLA.

requiredEvidence.title: govulncheck scan
requiredEvidence.description: govulncheck output showing reachable vulnerabilities in the module graph.
